```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Environment and Global Configuration
# ==============================================================================
# This is the FACE-PHASE counterpart of Pipline_UG_OfferPhase.Rmd, restricted
# to Experiment 1 (E1, sequential design: face precedes offer). In E2 the face
# and offer are simultaneous, so there is no separable face phase — hence this
# script is E1-only by construction.
#
# It mirrors the offer-phase pipeline's structure (versioned paths, method
# toggle, config-driven component windows, Baseline-as-covariate columns) so
# the two phases share conventions, but it is otherwise self-contained: the
# face-phase analysis is expected to appear as supplementary material.

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
if (!require("here"))   install.packages("here")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, reticulate, readr, stringr, here, fs)

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Experiment Version (FIXED to E1; face phase is E1-only)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Kept as a variable so the versioned path scheme matches the offer pipeline,
# but the face phase does not exist for E2 (simultaneous presentation).
experiment_version <- "E1"
if (experiment_version != "E1") {
  stop("Face phase is defined only for E1 (sequential design). E2 has no separable face phase.")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Method Configuration (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# FALSE = Regression Method (PRIMARY): no baseline subtraction; baseline is
#         extracted as Baseline_<comp> covariate columns -> Alday (2019).
# TRUE  = Standard Method  (SENSITIVITY): subtract -200..0 ms baseline mean.
use_baseline_correction <- TRUE

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline Parameters (only relevant when use_baseline_correction == TRUE)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
use_full_prestim_baseline <- FALSE

baseline_arg <- NULL
if (use_baseline_correction) {
  if (use_full_prestim_baseline) {
    baseline_arg <- list(NULL, 0.0)   # start of epoch to 0 ms
  } else {
    baseline_arg <- c(-0.2, 0.0)      # conventional -200..0 ms
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Phase Control
# -----------------------------------------------------------
run_face_phase <- TRUE

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Path Definitions (versioned, mirrors the offer pipeline)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
path_py_pipeline_src <- here("python_modules", "hu-neuro-pipeline")

path_raw_eeg     <- here("data", "00_Raw_Input", paste0("raw_all_cropped_", experiment_version))
path_raw_log     <- here("data", "00_Raw_Input", paste0("csv_all_", experiment_version))

path_csv_filtered <- here("data", paste0("01_Preprocessing_Logs_", experiment_version), "csv_filtered")
path_csv_summary  <- here("data", paste0("01_Preprocessing_Logs_", experiment_version), "csv_summary")
path_output_root  <- here("data", paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", experiment_version))

if (use_baseline_correction) {
  path_suffix   <- "Standard_Baseline"
  method_folder <- "Method_Standard"
} else {
  path_suffix   <- "No_Baseline"
  method_folder <- "Method_Regression"
}

dir_face_name <- "Face_Locked"   # sibling of Stimulus_Locked / Response_Locked

path_dest_face       <- file.path(path_output_root, method_folder, dir_face_name)
path_dest_covariates <- file.path(path_output_root, "Covariates")
path_dest_baseline   <- file.path(path_output_root, "Baseline_Raw")
path_dest_report     <- file.path(path_dest_face, "report")

dirs_to_create <- c(
  path_csv_filtered, path_csv_summary, path_output_root,
  path_dest_face, path_dest_covariates, path_dest_baseline, path_dest_report
)
purrr::walk(dirs_to_create, ~dir.create(., showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE))

# Defensive check: raw-input directories must exist for E1.
if (!dir.exists(path_raw_eeg)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Raw EEG directory not found:\n  %s\nExpected layout: data/00_Raw_Input/raw_all_cropped_E1/",
    path_raw_eeg))
}
if (!dir.exists(path_raw_log)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Raw log directory not found:\n  %s\nExpected layout: data/00_Raw_Input/csv_all_E1/",
    path_raw_log))
}
```

# 2. Python Environment Initialization

```{r Environment, include=FALSE}
# Mirrors the offer pipeline exactly. NOTE: the offer pipeline successfully
# epochs E1 .set files WITHOUT any S-format monkey patch (see results/EEG/
# Results_*_E1/), so the vendored pipeline already handles E1 markers. The
# legacy face script's get_events patch is therefore intentionally omitted.
use_condaenv("r-reticulate", required = TRUE)
py_pipeline_path <- path_py_pipeline_src

py_run_string("
import sys
import os
import importlib

local_path = r.py_pipeline_path
if os.path.exists(local_path):
    if local_path not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, local_path)

try:
    import pipeline
    importlib.reload(pipeline)
except ImportError as e:
    print(f'Error: Could not import pipeline. {e}')
")

pipeline_mod <- import("pipeline")
```

# 3. Log Preprocessing

```{r log-preprocessing}
# Identical cleaning to the offer pipeline; idempotent (same csv_filtered output),
# so this script does not depend on the offer pipeline having been run first.
orig_logs <- list.files(path_raw_log, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
cat("Processing", length(orig_logs), "log files for Experiment:", experiment_version, "\n")

for (fpath in orig_logs) {
  fb  <- file(fpath, "rb")
  bom <- readBin(fb, "raw", n = 2)
  close(fb)
  encoding <- if (length(bom) == 2 && identical(bom, as.raw(c(0xFF, 0xFE)))) "UTF-16LE" else "UTF-8"

  df <- read_delim(fpath, delim = "\t", col_types = cols(), show_col_types = FALSE,
                   locale = locale(encoding = encoding))
  n <- nrow(df)

  df_trials <- df %>%
    slice(1:(n - 3)) %>% filter(block != 7) %>%
    mutate(emotion = str_extract(stim, "enj|dis|dom|neu|aff"))

  df_summary <- df %>% slice((n - 2):n)

  out_name         <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fpath)), ".csv")
  out_name_summary <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fpath)), "_summaryPostRating.csv")

  write_csv(df_trials,  file.path(path_csv_filtered, out_name))
  write_csv(df_summary, file.path(path_dest_covariates, out_name_summary))
}
cat("Log preprocessing complete.\n")
```

# 4. Condition Definitions (Face Phase)

```{r define-conditions}
# ==============================================================================
# Face-phase condition pooling.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# In E1 the face precedes the offer, so at face onset the offer is NOT yet known
# and cannot be a meaningful factor — the only manipulated dimension is `emotion`
# (5 facial expressions). Conditions are therefore split by emotion alone.
#
# Trial inclusion is kept ALIGNED with the offer-phase and behavioral analyses
# (project always-on criterion): reaction > 0 AND RT in [300, 3000] ms. The face
# and offer epochs come from the same trials, so using the same inclusion keeps
# the two phases on an identical trial set. (This is stricter than the legacy
# face script, which omitted the RT filter.)
# ==============================================================================

rt_lower_ms <- 300
rt_upper_ms <- 3000
incl <- sprintf("reaction>0 & RT >= %d & RT <= %d", rt_lower_ms, rt_upper_ms)

face_average_by <- list(
  Face_enj = sprintf("emotion=='enj' & %s", incl),
  Face_aff = sprintf("emotion=='aff' & %s", incl),
  Face_dis = sprintf("emotion=='dis' & %s", incl),
  Face_dom = sprintf("emotion=='dom' & %s", incl),
  Face_neu = sprintf("emotion=='neu' & %s", incl),
  # Pooled smile cell (3 smile types) — used only as a permutation localizer.
  Face_smile = sprintf("(emotion=='enj' | emotion=='aff' | emotion=='dom') & %s", incl)
)

copy_trials_csv <- function(src_dir, dest_dir, new_filename = "trials.csv") {
  src_trials <- file.path(src_dir, "trials.csv")
  if (file.exists(src_trials)) {
    file.copy(src_trials, file.path(dest_dir, new_filename), overwrite = TRUE)
  }
}
```

# 5. ERP Component Extraction (Face Phase)

```{r face-phase}
if (run_face_phase) {

  out_face <- path_dest_face
  if (!dir.exists(out_face)) dir.create(out_face, recursive = TRUE)

  face_raw_files <- list.files(path_raw_eeg, pattern = "\\.(set|vhdr)$",
                               full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(face_raw_files) == 0) stop("CRITICAL: No EEG files found.")

  cat("\n=== Running Face-Locked Extraction (E1) ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Method: %s\n", path_suffix))

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Component definitions read from the FACE-PHASE config (separate from the
  # offer-phase config/erp_components.csv to keep the offer pipeline untouched).
  # Currently classic literature windows for P1/N170/EPN/LPP_face. To change a
  # window/ROI or add/remove a component, edit ONLY config/erp_components_face_E1.csv.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  comp_csv <- here("config", "erp_components_face_E1.csv")
  if (!file.exists(comp_csv)) stop(sprintf("Component config not found: %s", comp_csv))

  comp_def <- readr::read_csv(comp_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  required_cols <- c("experiment", "comp_name", "t_min", "t_max", "roi")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(comp_def))) {
    stop(sprintf("config/erp_components_face_E1.csv must contain columns: %s",
                 paste(required_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  comp_def <- comp_def[comp_def$experiment == experiment_version, ]
  if (nrow(comp_def) == 0) stop("No component rows for E1 in config/erp_components_face_E1.csv")

  erp_config <- tibble::tibble(
    comp_name    = comp_def$comp_name,
    t_min        = comp_def$t_min,
    t_max        = comp_def$t_max,
    roi_channels = strsplit(comp_def$roi, "|", fixed = TRUE)
  )

  # Regression/Alday method: additionally extract an ROI-specific pre-stimulus
  # baseline (-200..0 ms) per component, named Baseline_<comp>, to enter the
  # downstream LMM as a covariate.
  if (!use_baseline_correction) {
    baseline_config <- erp_config %>%
      mutate(comp_name = paste0("Baseline_", comp_name), t_min = -0.200, t_max = 0.000)
    final_config <- bind_rows(erp_config, baseline_config)
  } else {
    final_config <- erp_config
  }

  components_arg <- list(
    name = as.list(final_config$comp_name),
    tmin = as.list(final_config$t_min),
    tmax = as.list(final_config$t_max),
    roi  = final_config$roi_channels
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster-permutation localizers (optional, supplementary). Emotion is the
  # only face-phase factor, so the primary localizer is a negative-valence
  # contrast (Disgust vs Neutral); a pooled-smile vs Neutral contrast captures
  # positive valence. These generate clusters.csv/perm.csv for optional later
  # use; they do not define the measurement windows (those are classic, fixed
  # in the config above).
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  perm_contrasts_list <- list(
    c("Face_dis",   "Face_neu"),
    c("Face_smile", "Face_neu")
  )

  res_face <- pipeline_mod$group_pipeline(
    raw_files        = face_raw_files,
    log_files        = path_csv_filtered,
    output_dir       = out_face,
    epochs_dir       = file.path(out_face, "epochs"),

    ica_method       = "fastica",
    ica_n_components = 0.99,
    triggers         = c(101:105, 111:115, 201:205, 211:215), # E1 face-onset codes (log stim_trigger)
    epochs_on_missing = "raise",
    bad_channels     = "auto",
    highpass_freq    = 0.05,
    lowpass_freq     = 30.0,
    reject_peak_to_peak = 200.0,
    baseline         = baseline_arg,

    components       = components_arg,
    average_by       = face_average_by,

    perm_contrasts   = perm_contrasts_list,
    perm_tmin        = 0.050,
    perm_tmax        = 0.800,
    perm_channels    = NULL
  )

  # Archive the per-trial ERP table to the method-specific Face_Locked dir.
  # (group_pipeline already writes trials.csv into out_face; copy_trials_csv is
  # a no-op safety net retained for parity with the offer pipeline.)
  if (!use_baseline_correction) {
    out_bl_archive <- file.path(path_dest_baseline, "Face_Locked_Values")
    if (!dir.exists(out_bl_archive)) dir.create(out_bl_archive, recursive = TRUE)
    copy_trials_csv(out_face, out_bl_archive, "baseline_values.csv")
  }
}
```

```{r summary}
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("       FACE-PHASE PREPROCESSING DONE       \n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Experiment:      ", experiment_version, "(face-locked)\n")

cat("Output Root:     ", path_output_root, "\n\n")

if (run_face_phase) {
  cat("Face-Locked single-trial table:\n   ",
      file.path(path_dest_face, "trials.csv"), "\n")
  if (!use_baseline_correction) {
    cat("Baseline columns (Baseline_<comp>) are included in the same trials.csv.\n")
  }
}
cat("\nNOTE: E1 timing = face 1500 ms -> fixation 500 ms -> offer (>=2000 ms post\n")
cat("face onset). The LPP_face window (500-800 ms) is therefore well clear of the\n")
cat("offer onset; no offer-evoked contamination of the face-locked components.\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```
